summary: The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in instruments in its index or in instruments that have economic characteristics similar to those in the index. The underlying index is a free-float adjusted market capitalization weighted index modified per the 10/40 Constraint designed to measure the equity market performance of Chinese companies in the industrial, utility, real estate and technology sectors that contribute to a more environmentally sustainable economy. It is non-diversified.
